dog.description_text:
Lane is a mixed breed, small sized puppy with exactly one mission in life: to play. She’s one of the wriggliest, most joyful pups you’ll ever meet, with floppy ears that bounce everywhere she goes and a sneaky, quiet pounce she loves to practice on her sister, Harley.

Lane is friendly with everyone she meets. She enjoys people and kids alike, though she’s usually having too much fun to sit still for pets! She is curious and polite when meeting other animals, and is off to a great start with house training on her pee pads.

Lane would be a great fit for an adopter who’s excited to keep up with her playful spirit and help her learn the ropes during this fun puppy stage. With some guidance, plenty of toys, and lots of love, she’s sure to grow into a wonderful companion.

Registered adopters interested in Lane can email adopt@hbrdogs.org for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.org!
